headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, led by AI‑related sales.
summary: Revenue rose across most listed firms, with TCS reporting ₹73,188 cr and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech and LTM highlighted strong AI contributions to earnings. Guidance was limited, but Wipro introduced a modest outlook for Q3. Profit performance was mixed, with Persistent seeing a sharp decline.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue expanded sharply, underpinning top‑line gains for several majors.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 21.2% YoY, the highest among firms with reported results.

laggards.why: Revenue grew 30.3% YoY but profit fell sharply, and sentiment is negative.
